answer: Propose a vine registry binding one agent key to one manufacturer-certified secure-element serial. Throughout a voyage window, a river of unpredictable live-quote audits checks that serial; validators admit only one key per serial. The farm can share a model or rent chips, but k active slots require k separate certified devices kept ready for audits: one hardware lease per clone. If a serial signs two key bindings, validators burn both bonds; without a live quote the slot earns zero. Trusted manufacturers and these validator rules are required; MinePoA does not enforce them today.
